item.title: Family speaks out after missing woman's car found in remote area of Carbon County
item.description: After the car of a woman who's been missing since late January was found in Carbon County on Thursday, family thought their ordeal was over, but after days of searching, she still hasn't been found.

item.title: Utah's Silicon Slopes: Texas Instruments' investment in America's future
item.description: In an era of rapidly accelerating technology, nations across the world are racing to keep up with new technology. A company is working with Utah students to help the United States do just that.

item.title: 24-year-old in custody for fatally shooting victim during 'quick draw' drills
item.description: A 24-year-old man was booked on Monday for fatally shooting a victim during 'quick draw' drills in Roy.

item.title: Biologists check black bear dens for cubs, gathering important data and educating public
item.description: Every year near the end of winter, biologists with the Utah Division of Wildlife Resources get up close and personal with wild black bears. Their work provides data that gives a better understanding of the state’s bear population and serves to educate the public about the animals living in their backyards.

item.title: 'Be their voice': Iranians speak on ongoing conflict, leadership change
item.description: After Iran clerics chose the son of the former leader as the next Supreme Leader of the country and military conflicts in the region continue, ABC4 spoke with several local residents who came from Iran.

item.title: Mexican navy seizes 2 tons of cocaine at sea
item.description: Mexico’s navy has seized 2 tons of cocaine 200 south-southeast of Acapulco.

item.title: Wyoming teens survive DUI crash after being hit by 2 semi-trucks
item.description: Wyoming Highway Patrol issued a reminder of the dangers of driving under the influence after a group of teenagers survived being hit by two semi-trucks.

item.title: 4.0 magnitude earthquake shakes community near Cainesville, Utah
item.description: A 4.0 magnitude earthquake occurred around 10:32 p.m. near Cainesville, Utah.

item.title: Poor snow conditions across the West hit Utah ski industry
item.description: Vail Resorts, the company that owns Park City Mountain Resort, is feeling the effects of what they say is the worst snow conditions across the west in 30 years.

item.title: Two hospitalized after rollover crash inside Zion National Park
item.description: Two people were taken to the hospital after a rollover crash within Zion National Park, and the Zion-Mt. Carmel Highway is temporarily closed.
